items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: the only people that were making any money in that Bass Choir were Richard Davis, Ron Carter and me.

ctx.x: Isn’t he, really. He was part of the choir.

He was a conductor in the Bass Choir, in the young bass player’s choir. He was a conductor. And then he didn’t have anybody, and didn’t care about anybody. And the only people that were making any money in that Bass Choir were Richard Davis, Ron Carter and me. We were making a record date. And we was working a lot.

items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: At that time Ron Carter, Richard Davis, and yours truly, and Sam Jones, we were doing… Just about every day.

ctx.x: Was Oscar on the faculty up there?
Yes, Oscar was on the faculty. Ron Carter studied with him.
